description: ADVANCED ROUTING-ONLY TOOL. Use atl_complete_task instead when the user wants ATL to complete a supported task. Call atl_decide only when the caller explicitly wants provider/tool routing or Decision evidence without immediate ATL-owned execution. Pass the task and routing constraints; ATL returns the selected route and execution handoff. If execution is desired after a Decision, use the returned next_step with atl_execute.

auth_available.description: Whether the caller can authenticate to the selected provider.

constraints.description: Optional routing constraints that ATL should honor when selecting an eligible provider or tool.

desired_outcome.description: Optional result the caller wants from the task.

max_retries.description: Optional maximum retries allowed for the decision request.

preferences.description: Optional trade-offs such as cost, latency, or reliability.

required_capability.description: Optional capability hint. ATL's Task Intelligence layer normally derives the capability and semantic constraints from the task.

task.description: The natural-language task or routing goal. Include relevant input, constraints, and desired output.

timeout_ms.description: Optional time limit for the decision request in milliseconds.

name: atl_decide
